title: Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/LoginPage.ts
goal:
Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/LoginPage.ts

This is a Playwright Page Object for the Libre LMS login page. The Razor page at src/Host/Pages/Account/Login.cshtml has:
- An email input with label "Email" (asp-for="Email")
- A password input with label "Password" (asp-for="Password")  
- A submit button with text "Sign In" (button type="submit")
- Error messages shown in .error-message div

The file should:
- Extend BasePage from '../pages/BasePage'
- Export a LoginPage class
- Have locators: emailInput (by label "Email"), passwordInput (by label "Password"), signInButton (by role button "Sign In"), errorMessage (.error-message)
- Have methods: login(email, password) that fills and submits, isOnLoginPage() that checks URL
- Import { Page, Locator } from '@playwright/test'
